verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export feature, no bulk or complete-account export, and no stated offboarding or exit path. What it does show is a JSON API and MCP tools for pulling messages, calls, and contacts. Those are developer building blocks a user could script an export from, not the export capability itself. 'Cancel anytime' is an adjacent billing control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
